result.title: Can We Stop the Backtest Yet? Anytime-Valid Promotion Tests for Adaptive Financial Research Agents
result.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at ICAIF 2026, Milan, Italy
result.summary: Financial research agents can generate and monitor trading rules faster than a human can document the resulting selection process. Candidates appear at data-dependent times, weak rules are abandoned, and promising ones are watched until they cross a reporting threshold. We introduce PROMOTE, a protocol that assigns every candidate predictable testing wealth at birth and accumulates a cost-aware e-process only from subsequent returns. If lifetime allocations sum to at most one, a weighted Ville argument bounds the probability of ever promoting a rule whose declared bounded net score has always had nonpositive conditional mean. The result permits dependent candidates, adaptive births, and indefinite monitoring. We audit the implementation in two settings. A retrospective pseudo-out-of-sample replay contains 24 panel--rule hypotheses, 3,000 shared-sign null paths, injected alternatives, and public ETF and industry data. Repeated unadjusted tests produce a family crossing in 94.5% of null paths, versus 0.0% for PROMOTE; at a 15-bp aligned ETF-component perturbation, PROMOTE has 70.1% target power and median crossing session 2,327. A separate exact mean-zero experiment lets an agent select candidate identities and birth times from past scores; the funded gate has 1.77% false-family crossings across 3,000 programs. The market replay produces zero promotions after costs. The certificate controls historical false promotion under the declared null; it is not a certificate that an earlier edge remains profitable at deployment. AI-use disclosure. Generative AI tools, including OpenAI Codex, assisted manuscript preparation. For this preprint version, Codex assisted with LaTeX editing, author and venue metadata, compilation, and layout checks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PROMOTE 协议：在候选规则诞生时分配可预测的“检验财富”，仅用后续收益累积成本感知的 e-process，借助加权 Ville 不等式控制「曾错误晋升一个真实条件均值为非正的候选」的概率，并在金融历史回放与合成均值零实验中审计其错误晋升率与功效。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 anytime-valid 停止与对数据依赖候选的动态财富预算，可能为 LVR 中「何时继续搜索/停止并采纳某个推理候选」及计算预算分配提供可核查的统计框架，但需核查能否迁移到多模态推理状态的验证与晋升。
